title: Eight-Game Mix

tutorial.discipline: The discipline in play. The table rotates Limit Hold'em, Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, No-Limit Hold'em, Pot-Limit Omaha and 2-7 Triple Draw, and the rules change with it.
tutorial.seats: Chips and visible cards per seat. The stud disciplines show everyone's door cards; 2-7 Triple Draw shows nothing but your own hand.
tutorial.actions: Betting works the same in every discipline. Only 2-7 Triple Draw asks you to pick cards to exchange. Chips carry across disciplines, and the match ends as soon as a seat busts.

frontendHint.horseNextHand: The hand is settled — deal the next one
frontendHint.horseDisciplineChanged: The discipline just changed; check the rules before you act
frontendHint.horseOmahaUsesTwo: Omaha uses exactly two of your hole cards
frontendHint.horseRazzWantsLow: In Razz the lowest hand wins
frontendHint.horsePlayTheDiscipline: Play by the rules of the current discipline
rules.holdem: Make the best five-card hand using any combination of your two hole cards and the five community cards.
rules.omahaHiLo: Use exactly two hole cards and three community cards. The pot is split between the best high hand and a qualifying low hand.
rules.razz: Make the lowest five-card hand from seven cards; straights and flushes do not count against you, and aces are low.
rules.stud: Build the best five-card hand from seven cards dealt face up or down; there are no community cards.
rules.studHiLo: Build a high hand and a qualifying low hand from seven cards; the pot is split between them.
rules.nlHoldem: Make the best five-card hand from your two hole cards and five community cards. You may bet any amount up to your stack.
rules.plOmaha: Use exactly two hole cards and three community cards. Bets can be up to the current pot.
rules.tripleDraw: Make the lowest five-card hand, with aces high and straights and flushes counting against you. Exchange cards up to three times.

draw.prompt: Draw {{n}} - pick the cards to exchange

frontendHint.horseDrawTurn: It is your draw. Pick the cards to exchange, or stand pat.
